name: surveyor_assignments
description: Survey assignment registry. Each feature is one assignment; its geometry is the assigned boundary (longitude/latitude, WGS 84). 'assigned_to' lists the sign-in e-mail addresses of the surveyors who hold the assignment. An assignment with "is_demo": true is offered to signed-in users who hold no assignment of their own, and is labelled DEMO everywhere in the application.

properties.boundary_source: Placeholder rectangle entered by hand for the prototype; not a surveyed or notified boundary.
